atom_order: Unchanged 91-atom frozen A order; IDs below are one-based.
axis_definition: u=normalize(C89-O90); l=(target_x-O90_x,target_y-O90_y,0); t=normalize(l-dot(l,u)*u); axis=normalize(cross(u,t)). Right-handed Rodrigues rotation about O90.
positive_angle_meaning: The C89 direction initially moves toward the selected lateral phosphate-O image.
direction_scope: O72+a is the deterministic nearest choice; nearly equivalent O73-b/O74 directions exist. This selection is prespecification, not a claim of unique physical preference.
target_selection: Among substrate O1..O88 with nearest P<1.9A and nearest H>1.25A under 3D MIC, enumerate in-plane images na,nb=-1..1,nc=0; choose shortest 3D distance from O90 with nonzero lateral displacement; ties atom ID then image tuple.
method: Exact existing A PBE-D3(BJ),1200/80Ry,DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH/GTH-PBE,EPS_SCF1e-8,XYZ periodic,Z dipole position2.0/switchF; no recentering or cell change.

baseline.energy_role: converged final_energy_only at unchanged endpoint coordinates
baseline.repeatability_limit: The tiny force/energy-only difference is one existing same-geometry repeat, not an independent cold-start/grid uncertainty bound.

analysis.torque: tau(theta)=sum over atoms89,91 of axis dot ((r_i(theta)-center) cross F_i(theta)); force unmodified eV/A
analysis.directional_candidate: D<-0.001eV, K_E<0 and K_F<0, finite complete labels and original QA; classify as candidate downhill direction under the frozen method, not a proven saddle eigenmode.
analysis.quantitative_consistency: Record K_E and K_F separately. Opposite signs or a ratio of absolute magnitudes outside [0.5,2] is inconclusive, not an automatic failure of chemistry.
analysis.classification_precedence: Incomplete/failed-QA labels first; then near-noise or inconsistent curvature is inconclusive and overrides directional_candidate, even if both curvatures are negative. Only complete, consistent data can enter the candidate-downhill category.
analysis.numerical_reliability: EPS_SCF is not an energy error bound. For a marginal/discordant result, at most one matched E0/E+/E- EPS_SCF1e-9 batch may be proposed by E/A. Require the negative D to exceed both 1meV and ten times max absolute E differences between matched SCF levels, with sign/torque agreement. No repeated tightening ladder.
analysis.strong_negative_followup: A consistent D below -1meV can prioritize a separately bounded all-mobile relaxation from the lower-energy prepared variant; retain directional-screen qualification until tighter-SCF/method controls or the relaxed result resolve it.
analysis.nonnegative_result: Only no detected negative direction at this chosen angle; no full local-minimum statement.
analysis.zero_noise_handling: Do not interpret numerical zeros, small negative curvatures or apparent cancellations as proof. Preserve raw values and classify unresolved.

E_preflight: Verify source/variant hashes and atom order
Use existing fixed image/assets and protected resource admission
Freeze two input hashes with only RUN_TYPE/geometry/necessary project-output changes
Prefer matching A WFN independently for each geometry; no cross-feeding plus to minus
Record SCF and all raw forces, energy, cell, exit/QA and resource/time metadata
